title: Canonical sequence direct image commutes with evaluation
statement: Use the coefficient sequence site of [def-coef-ringed-sequence-site] and the canonical sequence operations of [def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems]. For a scheme morphism f : X ⟶ Y and a nonnegative level n, integralComparisonSequenceDirectImage for the canonical constant-section ring map, followed by coefficientSequenceEvaluation at n, is naturally isomorphic to evaluation at n followed by the finite coefficient pro-etale module direct image. There is exactly one such isomorphism whose hom acts by identity on every section. No arbitrary sequence ring map is allowed.

source.place: Tags 03D1 and 0941: sectionwise direct image on the ringed sequence site

proof.text: Compose the module-pushforward composition isomorphisms on the two sides of the square formed by sequence base change and level-n inclusions. Their coefficient maps agree: the evaluation identification is equality on the coefficient ring sheaf, while the canonical sequence ring map has the finite constant-section map as its component. Sheaf and natural-transformation extensionality prove equality of these maps. Insert pushforwardCongr for this equality between the two composition isomorphisms. Their section component equations show the resulting isomorphism is the identity on every section. If another isomorphism has this property, heterogeneous transitivity makes its hom equal on every section to the constructed hom; module-sheaf, natural-transformation, and isomorphism extensionality give equality.

lean.statement:
theorem integralComparisonSequenceDirectEvaluation_existsUnique
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℕ) :
    ∃! e : integralComparisonSequenceDirectImage l E f ⋙ coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n ≅
      coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E X n ⋙
        coefficientProEtaleModuleDirectImage.{u, u} f
          (CommRingCat.of (ULift.{u + 1} (finiteCoefficientRing l E (n + 1)))),
      ∀ (M : coefficientSequenceModules l E X) (U : Y.ProEt)
        (x : ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n).obj
          ((integralComparisonSequenceDirectImage l E f).obj M)).val.obj (op U)),
        HEq ((e.hom.app M).val.app (op U) x) x
